checkpoints.description: [1/6] Plan Weft: pure thread-routing engine, twelve frozen chambers, static UI, local server, and Play-catalog deployment

impact_assessment.why: The AegeanWorks Play catalog has one browser game; a second original static puzzle proves the catalog is a real multi-game surface and gives visitors a new zero-install title.
impact_assessment.benefits: A complete, offline-capable browser puzzle with deterministic engine tests, stored solutions for hints, versioned progress, and a one-command site sync; no runtime dependencies and no server needed on Pages.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new project plus a third Play-catalog entry; dependency: none beyond Node 20 for tests and tooling; concurrency: the website playable-games task is uncommitted and must not be overwritten; state: localStorage progress and copied build digests.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Build and test the engine before UI, freeze every level with a stored solution, add only one new GAMES entry and one workflow checkout, preserve the existing uncommitted website work, and run the project and site gates before any commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Deliver the pure engine, twelve chambers, static UI, server, 51 tests and browser dogfood; checklists: passed; gates: test, mechanics, dogfood, hygiene, guidelines, secrets
